task: Issue #34654: Agentic Omnichannel Customer Context Memory Architecture
implementation_details: Implemented `customer_memory_context` postgres table with RLS tenant isolation. Implemented a job queue background worker in Rust to automatically dequeue from `interaction_event_jobs` via `SKIP LOCKED` and extract features/facts to append to `context_graph` and `profile_summary`. Updated Next.js frontend pages (Customer Detail View and ContextCard) to retrieve from the proxy `/api/v1/memory/summary/{id}` API route and styled using OHC Premium Translucent Glass tokens.
issues_found: A poison pill was created by attempting to query a strictly RLS-enabled table without setting `app.current_tenant` in the SQL transaction context first.
lessons_learned: When implementing custom background workers that modify multitenant data in OHC, `::server_common::auth_utils::set_org_context(&mut *tx, &tenant_id).await?` must be invoked inside the database transaction before performing any queries to avoid RLS violations.
